title: A Wide Dispersion in Star Formation Rate and Dynamical Mass of 10<SUP>8</SUP> Solar Mass Black Hole Host Galaxies at Redshift 6
question: What are the star formation rates and dynamical masses of host galaxies of z>6 quasars with black hole masses <1e9 Msun, and how do they relate to black hole mass?

recipe.method: CASA imaging with natural weighting, no channel binning, uv continuum subtraction; continuum from three line-free basebands

recipe.goal: Extract spectra, moment maps and fluxes
recipe.method: Moment-zero from channels with >~2 sigma emission (central 20 channels for non-detections); elliptical aperture 1.5x source FWHM (1.5x beam for non-detections); errors from random apertures
LFIR (42.5-122.5 um) from 1.2 mm continuum with greybody; SFR=1.5e-10 LFIR; SFR=1e-7 L[CII]
assumptions: Td=47 K, beta=1.6, Chabrier IMF, all dust heated by star formation

recipe.method: Orthogonal distance regression on 22 z>5.7 quasars

recipe.goal: Dynamical masses and comparison with BH mass and simulations
recipe.method: Thin disk: i=arccos(amin/amaj), vcir=0.75 FWHM/sin i, Mdyn=1.16e5 vcir^2 D; D=1.5x deconvolved FWHM; compare with MassiveBlack-II
assumptions: D=4.5 kpc for unresolved; inclination 55 deg when minor axis unavailable
